items.source_en:
Welcome back to the Empire questline! Some things have changed since you all last played that I thought it'd be worth calling out, which are listed below.

As well, I've added a "Last Time on UC Playtesting" story recap which you can access with the following console command:
setstage UC04 15

LONDINION
You're going to be hearing a lot about a place called "Londinion" going forward. The earlier quests have all been updated to teach the player about this place, but you should know the following:

- It was once a thriving settlement, but it's since been completely overrun by Rakghouls
- The Rakghoul sample you found on Jinata (where you met Hadrian), back in UC02 is an exact match for tissue from Londinion, meaning the outbreak that happened there could happen anywhere.

THE VANGUARD
The player has already recieved permission from this Imperial Fleet commander to persue this line of inquiry. The player working with Hadrian is all above board.

ROBOVOICE
A substantial amount of robovoice never got overwritten when I finished this quest. I've tried to correct the spots I found, but these do your best to see past it if you encounter it.
items.legacy_ko:
제국 퀘스트 라인이 돌아왔습니다! 지난번 플레이 이후 변경된 사항 중 주목할 만한 점을 아래에 정리했습니다.

또한, 다음 콘솔 명령어로 확인할 수 있는 "지난 UC 플레이테스트 요약" 스토리를 추가했습니다:
setstage UC04 15

론디니온
앞으로 "론디니온"이라는 장소에 대해 자주 듣게 될 것입니다. 이전 퀘스트들은 모두 이 장소에 대해 플레이어에게 알려주도록 업데이트되었지만, 다음 사항은 반드시 알아두어야 합니다:

- 한때 번성하던 정착지였으나, 현재는 락굴에게 완전히 점령당했습니다.
- UC02에서 (해드리안을 만났던) 지나타에서 발견한 락굴 샘플은 론디니온의 조직 샘플과 정확히 일치합니다. 즉, 그곳에서 발생한 발병 사태는 어디서든 일어날 수 있다는 뜻입니다.

뱅가드
플레이어는 이미 이 제국군 사령관으로부터 이 조사 경로를 추적할 수 있는 허가를 받았습니다. 해드리안과 협력하는 것은 모두 정당한 절차입니다.

로봇 음성
이 퀘스트를 마쳤을 때 상당수의 로봇 음성이 덮어쓰기 되지 않았습니다. 발견한 부분은 수정하려고 노력했지만, 혹시 마주치더라도 너그러이 이해해 주시기 바랍니다.

Welcome back to the UC questline! Some things have changed since you all last played that I thought it'd be worth calling out, which are listed below.

As well, I've added a "Last Time on UC Playtesting" story recap which you can access with the following console command:
setstage UC04 15

LONDINION
You're going to be hearing a lot about a place called "Londinion" going forward. The earlier quests have all been updated to teach the player about this place, but you should know the following:

- It was once a thriving settlement, but it's since been completely overrun by Terrormorphs
- The Terrormorph sample you found on Tau Ceti (where you met Hadrian), back in UC02 is an exact match for tissue from Londinion, meaning the outbreak that happened there could happen anywhere.

THE VANGUARD
The player has already recieved permission from this Vanguard commander to persue this line of inquiry. The player working with Hadrian is all above board.

ROBOVOICE
A substantial amount of robovoice never got overwritten when I finished this quest. I've tried to correct the spots I found, but these do your best to see past it if you encounter it.
